name.description: The name the writer's token carried when the version was written. Null when not known.

current.description: Whether this is the published version the template sends.

jsx_source.description: The JSX source, React Email code; null when the version has none.

main_mode.description: The Authoring mode whose source is the Main source: its render is what the version sends.

plain_text_content.description: The Main source rendered as plain text.

published_at.description: When the version was published; null for a draft.

requested_subject.description: The subject the Template seed sent for its version. It can differ from subject: until the seed's conflict rule, the seed keeps the subject a template already has. Null on an operator's version and on the first versions, made from templates written before versions were kept.

seq.description: 1, 2, 3… within the template, in the order versions were written.

info.description: This is the API documentation for Skymail.
info.title: Skymail

get.description: Get a list of all mail tasks with pagination, newest first, each with its derived status, recipients by status and audience. The status filter keeps only sends with that derived status; X-Total-Count counts the filtered sends. Keycloak group names are looked up within 2 seconds for the whole page and are null past that.

parameters.description: Derived send status: failed (a recipient failed, or none was queued a minute after the send), sending (none failed and some pending or processing, or none queued yet within that minute), sent (none failed or queued, some sent)
parameters.name: status

X-Total-Count.description: Number of sends matching the filter

post.description: Create a new mail task and queue emails for all recipients. Supports both internal mailing lists and Keycloak groups.
Send a single email to a specific recipient using a template.

get.description: Queue rows (one per recipient) by status; sends by derived status, each equal to the X-Total-Count of the send list filtered by it; mail sent per Europe/Istanbul day over the last days (zero-filled, oldest first, ending today); and the latest sends. Derived status: failed (a recipient failed, or none was queued a minute after the send), sending (none failed and some pending or processing, or none queued yet within that minute), sent (none failed or queued, some sent).

parameters.description: Days in the daily series, ending today in Europe/Istanbul (1-90)
parameters.name: days

parameters.description: Latest sends to list, newest first (1-20)
parameters.name: recent

get.description: Get details of a specific mail task by its ID, with its derived status, recipients by status and audience, as the send list shows it.
get.summary: Get a mail task by ID

get.description: Get a send's recipients, one queue row each, newest first with the row id breaking ties so pages neither repeat nor skip a recipient. The status filter keeps only recipients in that queue status; X-Total-Count counts the filtered recipients.

X-Total-Count.description: Number of recipients matching the filter

get.summary: Get mail queue items for a task

get.description: Get a list of all mailing lists (internal + Keycloak groups) with pagination.

post.description: Create a new mailing list with the provided name.

delete.description: Archive a mailing list without removing recipients or historical mail tasks. Repeating the request is safe.

get.description: Get details of a specific mailing list by its ID. Falls back to Keycloak groups.
get.summary: Get a mailing list by ID

patch.description: Update an existing mailing list with the provided ID and details.

get.description: Get all recipients in a mailing list or Keycloak group with pagination.
get.summary: List recipients of a mailing list

post.description: Add a new recipient or link an existing one by email to a mailing list.
post.summary: Add a recipient to a mailing list

delete.description: Remove a specific recipient from a mailing list by their IDs.
delete.summary: Remove a recipient from a mailing list

post.description: Restore an archived internal mailing list. Repeating the request is safe.

get.description: Get a list of all email templates with pagination.

post.description: Create a new email template with the provided name, HTML content, and plain text content. Records the content as the template's first version: an operator's, published at once.

get.description: Get a template by its stable key (for example keycloak.verify-email).
get.summary: Get an email template by key

put.description: Seed path for system templates: creates the template when the key is new and replaces its content when it already exists. Un-archives the template so a seed always leaves a usable template behind. Records the content the template ends up with as a Template seed version, published at once.
put.summary: Create or replace a template addressed by key

delete.description: Archive an email template without removing historical mail tasks or queue items. Repeating the request is safe.

get.description: Get details of a specific email template by its ID.
get.summary: Get an email template by ID

patch.description: Update an existing email template with the provided ID and details. Records the content the template ends up with as an operator's version, published at once.

post.description: Restore an archived email template. Repeating the request is safe.

get.description: A Mail template's version history, newest first: who wrote each version (an operator, by the name their token carried, or a Template seed), when, whether it is published or a draft (published_at null), which Authoring mode is its Main source, the published version it started from, and which version the template sends (current). Sources and render are left out; read one version for them. An archived template's history stays readable.

X-Total-Count.description: Number of versions the template has

get.description: One Mail template version whole: its sources (at most one per Authoring mode, null where it has none), which is the Main source, and the Main source's render as HTML and plain text. A version of another template is not found.
get.summary: Read one version of a template
